name: Optical Flow High-Fidelity Slow Motion
purpose: Dramatize decisive sniper shot or final 1v1 clutch kill without frame jitter or judder.
required_visual_conditions: Clear visibility of victim and weapon, continuous camera motion, minimal overlapping smoke occlusion.
required_source_footage: 60 FPS minimum uncompressed CS2 demo capture via HLAE.
required_masks_or_mattes: None (operates on primary video buffer via optical vector estimation).
recommended_timing: 0.40s to 0.80s total duration around bullet impact.
recommended_color_palette: Inherits scene grade with subtle 5% saturation boost.
fusion_node_structure: MediaIn1 -> OpticalFlow1 (Output: Vectors) -> VectorMotionBlur1 -> TimeSpeed1 (Speed: 0.50, Interpolate: Flow) -> MediaOut1
resolve_implementation_instructions: Edit Page: Right-click clip -> Retime Process: Optical Flow, Motion Estimation: Enhanced Better. Retime curve speed point at impact frame lowered to 40%.
free_studio_compatibility: Compatible with DaVinci Resolve Free 21.0 & Studio
hardware_requirements: AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT / 8GB VRAM (OpenCL enabled)
qa_procedure: Inspect edges of crosshair and player silhouette for vector warping or ghosting; ensure no frame duplication.
